summary: First iteration frontend-only testing of 'Now Kart' UI foundation (placeholder data, no backend). Tested Home, Search, Product Detail, Categories, Orders screens, tab navigation, and interactive placeholder behaviors via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667). Metro bundler compiles cleanly with no console errors/red screens. Core flows work correctly: search filter/EmptyState, ADD-to-cart badge increment, wishlist toggle, category-card -> product-detail navigation, quantity stepper (min 1 enforced, total price updates live), hero 'Start shopping' CTA -> Categories tab, free delivery banner dismiss, Orders 'No orders yet' EmptyState. One notable issue found: bottom tab bar buttons (tabBarTestID) do not render a queryable `data-testid` attribute on web (expo-router Tabs limitation), so tab navigation could only be verified via text-based selector fallback, not testID as required by testing conventions.

ui_bugs.issue: tabBarTestID prop (tab-home, tab-categories, tab-orders) does not propagate to a `data-testid` attribute on the rendered DOM button on web. Verified via document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]') - no tab-related testids found despite tabBarTestID being set in code. Tab navigation only works via text-based selector (get_by_text) as a workaround, not via testID, which breaks the documented testID-based testing convention for this app.

action_items: Investigate expo-router Tabs tabBarTestID -> web data-testid propagation (may need a custom tabBar renderer with explicit testID on the TouchableOpacity, since expo-router's default web tab bar implementation may not forward tabBarTestID to the DOM). This affects automated testability of tab navigation.

Optional: product-add-to-cart-button on Product Detail screen has no onPress handler wired (label updates correctly with quantity, but tapping does nothing) - acceptable for this placeholder-only iteration per scope, but flagging for awareness before next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean, well-organized (feature-based structure), uses StyleSheet.create consistently, testID present on nearly all interactive elements except the tab bar buttons (see issue above).
No backend API calls detected anywhere in the frontend code for this iteration, consistent with the stated scope (pure UI/placeholder data).
Files are reasonably sized, no DRY violations observed in reviewed components.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing mock data in mockProducts.ts/mockCategories.ts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home, Search, Product Detail, Categories, Orders screens all verified working with mobile viewport. Tab bar navigation works functionally for the end user (verified via text click) but testID attribute does not surface on web DOM - needs a fix if automated testID-based tab testing is required in future iterations. No backend testing was performed per scope (explicitly excluded).
rca_of_issue: expo-router's Tabs component on web renders its own internal tab bar button implementation; the `tabBarTestID` option may only be forwarded to native tab bar renderers (iOS/Android) and not consistently applied as `data-testid`/`testID` on the underlying web Pressable/TouchableOpacity. A verified workaround is to use a custom tabBar (screenOptions.tabBar render prop) with explicit testID props on each tab button, ensuring consistent web + native testability.
